title: Tenant-aware adaptive ingest profiles and collector policies for Private/Dedicated observability
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Goal: implement per-tenant adaptive ingest profiles and collector-side policies for Private and Dedicated deployments to ensure tenant isolation, predictable cost, and signal quality for traces, metrics, and logs. This work complements the perimeter collectors and tenant-side agents by adding a policy layer in the control plane and small, deterministic behavior changes in the collector/sidecar to enable adaptive sampling, retention, throttling, and secure tenant token rotations.

Scope includes:
- Tracing hooks: tenant-aware header translation, trace-id namespace mapping for multi-tenant on-prem clusters, tail- and head-based sampling controls per tenant, and link-privacy redaction rules.
- Metrics/log pipelines: label enrichment, redaction rules, per-tenant routing to isolated retention buckets, backpressure signaling and soft-quota enforcement at collector ingress, and configurable Prometheus remote_write segregation.
- Dashboards and SLOs: tenant-level latency/error dashboards in Grafana (templated), alerting rules for cross-tenant error spikes, and cost-exposure panels for committed Dedicated capacity.

Non-goals: full tenant-aware billing pipeline (handled by billing infra), multi-region routing logic (separate initiative).
acceptance_criteria: Control plane can push per-tenant ingest profile (sampling, retention, quota) to collectors in Private/Dedicated deployments
Collectors enforce soft-quota and expose per-tenant metrics (ingest_rate, dropped_count, backpressure_active) to the observability backend
Tracing pipeline supports tenant trace-id translation without global collisions and preserves parent/child link semantics across tenant boundaries
Grafana dashboards include tenant variable, show 99th/median latency, error-rate, token usage, and a cost-estimate panel for Dedicated customers
No user-visible regression for hosted API customers; private/dedicated behavior behind feature flag and rollout policy
implementation_notes:
Design decisions: prefer control-plane-driven policies with stateless collector enforcement to keep collectors lightweight and restart-safe. Use per-tenant namespaces in trace IDs by prefixing hashed tenant namespace to the trace-id for on-prem collectors to avoid collisions when customers bring their own trace sources. Backpressure signaling: collectors will emit grpc health/metrics 'collector_backpressure' and return HTTP 429 with Retry-After for enforced soft-quota. Sampling: support a hybrid flow - head-based quick drop for extreme overload and tail-based samplers for error-preserving behavior.

Collector changes: add config block for 'tenant_profile' with fields {tenant_id, sampling.rate, retention_days, backpressure.soft_limit_mb, redaction_rules}. Implement small in-memory token bucket per-tenant and atomic counters to avoid locking hotspots. Metric labels should include 'tenant_id' and obfuscated 'customer_hash' for dashboards.

Operational/rollout plan: feature-flagged in obs-agent 2.9 canary -> internal dedicated infra on one cluster -> opt-in customer pilot -> automatic rollout with gradual ramp to 80% collectors. Provide migration tooling to backfill tenant label for existing metrics using temporal join job.

Privacy and security: use KMS-wrapped tenant tokens; collectors must not persist unhashed tenant tokens. Redaction rules configurable via control plane; default conservative set applied.
risks_mitigations: Risk: trace-id prefixing could collide with downstream ingest systems - Mitigation: use 128-bit hashed namespace + explicit header to avoid munging when the receiver understands namespaces
Risk: backpressure may cause customer-visible 429s - Mitigation: soft-quota with graceful degradation and fallback to lower-fidelity sampling; expose informative Retry-After and telemetry to SRE
Risk: per-tenant in-memory state increases collector memory - Mitigation: enforce LRU eviction for cold tenants and provide operator knobs for max tenants per collector
Risk: misconfigured redaction leaks PII - Mitigation: default conservative redaction, secure preview in staging, and required security review for custom rules
testing_plan: Unit + integration tests for tenant-profile parsing and enforcement, load test bench simulating 10k tenants with Zipf distribution, end-to-end trace integrity test across a tenant-crossing call path, and a canary run on dedicated-internal cluster with synthetic traffic. Add Prometheus rules to validate per-tenant counters and alert if dropped_rate > 0.5% during canary.
dashboards_and_alerting: Grafana templates: Tenant Overview (latency p50/p95/p99, error rate, traces per second), Ingest Health (per-tenant ingest_rate, dropped_count, backpressure_active), Cost Exposure (estimated tokens/day, retention multiplier). Alerting: tenant-error-rate-high (SLO breach), tenant-ingest-drop-spike (>0.5% drop), collector-memory-per-tenant-high. Links to templated dashboards will be under /dashboards/obs/private/tenant_overview.json
rollout_plan: Phase 1: design + control-plane API (2 weeks). Phase 2: agent changes + unit tests (3 weeks). Phase 3: internal canary on dedicated-internal + dashboards (2 weeks). Phase 4: opt-in pilot with 2 customers (2 weeks). Phase 5: gradual rollout behind feature flag to remaining private clusters (4 weeks).
dependencies_notes: Depends on collector routing/ingest changes in ENG-22147 and on agentless SDK schema work ENG-45123. Will reuse perimeter ingress patterns from ENG-4721 for token rotation and safe bootstrap. Coordinate with SRE and Solutions for pilot customers.
